# Baseline of advisories that are known and not fixable inside the version
# ranges pinned in requirements.txt. The audit job fails on anything NOT in
# this list, so new advisories still break the build.
#
# Clearing these entries requires widening the upper bounds in
# requirements.txt (PyJWT, fastapi/starlette, pytest), which is tracked as a
# separate dependency-upgrade change.

# PyJWT 2.10.1 (requirements pins <2.11.0; fixes land in 2.12.x / 2.13.0)
PYSEC-2025-183
PYSEC-2026-120
PYSEC-2026-175
PYSEC-2026-176
PYSEC-2026-177
PYSEC-2026-178
PYSEC-2026-179

# pytest 8.3.5 (requirements pins <8.4.0; fix lands in 9.0.3)
PYSEC-2026-1845

# starlette 0.46.2, pulled in by fastapi <0.116.0 (fixes need starlette >=1.3.1)
PYSEC-2026-161
PYSEC-2026-248
PYSEC-2026-249
PYSEC-2026-1941
PYSEC-2026-1942
PYSEC-2026-2280
PYSEC-2026-2281
